curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As their stepfather's rigid rule tightens, how will the children's devoted relatives manage to intervene?
curatedMovie.description: After the sudden death of their theatrical father, young Fanny and Alexander enter an austere, joyless household when their mother remarries an increasingly controlling bishop in early twentieth-century Sweden.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Deliberate, heavy, and immersive; an emotionally deep drama that unfolds with steady atmospheric weight.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Ingmar Bergman shapes an expansive family saga where childhood warmth clashes with severe domestic tyranny, threaded with mysterious, evocative undercurrents.
